title: The Last Orchard Again
author: Theo Montrose
blurb: Silas Underhill, a vineyard owner who inherited debts instead of grapes, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. But when a fake date to survive a family reunion feels too real by dessert, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces before the festival ends.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
